rex.wiki_ao_dia: The wiki already cites every source in raw/: nothing to build.
rex.construindo: Building the wiki: %d source(s) to process.
rex.revisando: Reviewing the wiki (links, index, orphan pages)…
rex.revision_incompleta: The final review did not complete: %v

rex.url_non_valida: “%s” is not a valid URL (http or https)

rex.moitos_pdf: There are many PDFs: only the first %d are added.
rex.ia_non_explora: The AI could not choose pages to explore: %v

rex.formulas_fallan: %s: the formulas could not be converted to LaTeX (%v); left as is

rex.figura: %s: a figure could not be cropped (%v): the whole page is used
erro.construindo: the vault is already being built
erro.sen_conversor: converter %s not found (it must be next to buxo)
erro.conversor_non_lanza: the converter could not be launched: %w
erro.sen_conexion_ia: there is no connection to the AI: open Buxo from Lua with an AI key configured
erro.sen_documentos: there are no converted documents yet: add files (PDF, images, Markdown...) first
erro.consultar_boveda: the vault could not be queried: %w
erro.tipo_ficheiro: “%s”: Buxo does not know how to handle that file type
erro.url_non_valida: the URL “%s” is not valid (only http and https)
erro.sen_pdftoppm: pdftoppm (poppler) is needed for the AI to read the pages
erro.precisa_ia: reading formulas and drawings needs the AI (open Buxo from Lua with an AI configured)
erro.tokens: the AI response was cut off by the token limit (raise it in Options)
motivo.pouco_texto: has little extractable text (scanned or made of images)
motivo.ilexible: the text comes out with unreadable characters
motivo.formulas_rotas: has formulas (the text comes out broken)
detalle.formulas_latex: the AI converts the formulas to LaTeX (%d/%d)
fallo.crear_boveda: the vault could not be created: %v
fallo.imaxe_ia: an image can only be read with the AI (switch the mode to Automatic)
conversor.sen_resultado: the converter finished without a result
ui.formatos: PDF, images (photos of exams, diagrams), Markdown, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML or EPUB.
ui.modo.auto: Automatic: the AI reads the pages only if there are formulas, drawings or it is scanned
ui.modo.vision: Always with the AI: the best result (slower and costs more)
ui.modo.texto: Text only: free and fast, but formulas and drawings are lost
ui.urls.rotulo: Or URLs (of a PDF or of a page to search for them)
ui.instrucion.rotulo: Filter instruction (optional): which PDFs from the page you want

ui.licenza.title: Buxo licence (MIT) and third-party notices
ui.modo.title: How each file is read
ui.instrucion.ph: E.g.: only exams from 2023 onwards; ignore the solutions
ui.cola.baleira: No files yet. Add PDFs, images, Markdown or URLs on the left: they will be converted to Markdown (with formulas in LaTeX) automatically.
ui.estado.sen_ia: Set up an AI key in Lua (Options) to build the vault.
ui.estado.sen_fontes: There are no converted PDFs yet: add files first.
ui.urls.axuda_ia: A URL that points to a PDF is downloaded directly; if it is a page, the AI looks in it for the PDFs useful for the project and applies the filter instruction, if you write one.
ui.urls.axuda_sen_ia: Without AI only URLs that point directly to a PDF are downloaded.
